# Netcraft Social — Operations

Latest Social results from the Integration Gateway (`NetcraftSocialResult_CL`). Use `NetcraftSocialResult_Latest` so re-delivered updates collapse to one row per `ResultUuid`. `Risk` is the `data.risk` object; charts use `Risk.category`. `SocialType` is `profile` or `content`.

content.query:
NetcraftSocialResult_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend RiskCategory = tostring(Risk.category)
| summarize Events = count() by RiskCategory
| order by Events desc
content.title: Results by risk

content.query:
NetcraftSocialResult_Unique
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Events = count() by ChangeType
| order by Events desc
content.title: Deliveries by change_type

content.query:
NetcraftSocialResult_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Events = count() by Platform
| order by Events desc
content.title: Latest results by platform

content.query:
NetcraftSocialResult_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend SocialType = iff(isempty(SocialType), "Others", SocialType)
| summarize Events = count() by SocialType
| order by Events desc
content.title: Latest results by social_type

content.query:
NetcraftSocialResult_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize
    Verified = countif(Verified == true),
    Unverified = countif(isnull(Verified) or Verified == false),
    Profiles = countif(SocialType == "profile"),
    Content = countif(SocialType == "content")
| project Metrics = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Metric", "Verified", "Count", Verified),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Unverified", "Count", Unverified),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Profiles", "Count", Profiles),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Content", "Count", Content))
| mv-expand Metrics
| project Metric = tostring(Metrics.Metric), Count = tolong(Metrics.Count)
content.title: Verified and social_type

content.query:
NetcraftSocialResult_Unique
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), ChangeType
| render timechart
content.title: Event volume over time

content.query:
NetcraftSocialResult_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| mv-apply Tag = Tags on (
    where tostring(Tag.category) == "input_required"
    | summarize InputRequiredTags = make_set(tostring(Tag.display_name))
  )
| where array_length(InputRequiredTags) > 0
| project TimeGenerated, Platform, SocialType, Username, DisplayName, Url, Risk, ChangeType, InputRequiredTags = strcat_array(InputRequiredTags, ", "), ResultUuid
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 200
content.title: Results pending client input (tag category input_required)

content.query:
NetcraftSocialResult_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where tostring(Risk.category) in ("highest", "high")
| project TimeGenerated, Platform, SocialType, Username, DisplayName, Url, Verified, Risk, ChangeType, ResultUuid, FirstSeen, LastSeen
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: High / highest risk results

content.query:
NetcraftSocialResult_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| project TimeGenerated, Platform, PlatformVariant, SocialType, Username, DisplayName, Url, ProfileId, Verified, Description, Risk, ChangeType, CloudEventType, Tags, ResultUuid, FirstSeen, LastSeen
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 200
content.title: Latest results
